description: Capabilities for the main window. The same applies to the Core Image experiment CLI (geoframe-ci-develop, a bundle.externalBin spawned by src/coreimage.rs); its app-defined commands preview_engine / develop_preview_coreimage, and get_presets (preset definitions, src/presets.rs) are allowed by default because build.rs defines no app command manifest, so no permission entry is needed for them. Dialog permissions are limited to dialog:allow-open (the source-folder picker) and dialog:allow-confirm (confirming a group move that discards manual adjustments; WKWebView does not show window.confirm; in tauri-plugin-dialog 2.x this permission is a deprecated alias that allows the underlying message command). dialog:allow-save / allow-message / allow-ask are intentionally not listed.
